Granularity (applies to every proof in this file): Lean core `withRWRulesSeq` wraps every rewrite rule in its own TacticInfo node that replaces the goal, so each rule is a step (origin of the rewritten goal, consumer of the previous one). The `rw` macro is `(rewrite [..]; with_annotate_state ] (try (with_reducible rfl)))`; here the rfl closes `im z = im z` (goal display: `im z = im z` at `]`, no goals just after it), so its rfl node consumes the last rule's goal. That rfl node's syntax is macro-synthesized with the span of the whole `rw`, so its line is the rw's first line. Ordering convention: by the line where the step's syntax starts, and within a line in execution order (macro-internal steps share one span, so column order is undefined for them).

`have := e` expands to `refine_lift have ..; ?_` = `focus (refine ..; rotate_right)`; the inner `refine` node is the step (consumes the goal, originates the continuation); `rotate_right` on one goal changes nothing. The rw's trailing rfl on the main goal fails (goal still displayed after line 263), so no rfl step.
